options: Both Figure Y and Figure Z
questions.hint: Congruent figures have the exact same shape and size. They can be rotated or reflected.

Therefore, Figure Z is congruent to Figure X.

questions.stem: In parallelogram \(ABCD\), prove that \(\triangle ACD\cong\triangle CAB\).
questions.hint: Use the parallel sides to find two equal angle pairs, then identify the shared diagonal AC.
questions.solution: Sample proof: Since AB is parallel to DC, alternate interior angles give ∠BAC=∠DCA. Since AD is parallel to BC, ∠DAC=∠ACB. The included side AC is common, so △ACD≅△CAB by ASA.

questions.stem: ABCD is a square. X lies on AD, Y lies on AB, and lines DY and CX meet at 90° at O. If \(\angle DCX=\alpha\), prove that \(\triangle DAY\cong\triangle CDX\).
